project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to be a complex educational platform, likely managing exam processes, student data, and potentially course enrollment. The codebase utilizes a component-based architecture, indicated by the numerous Vue files, and integrates routing for navigation. The file structure suggests a modular design, with separate components for specific features like exam submissions, fee details, and student profiles. Further investigation is needed to fully understand the application's core functionality and the interactions between its components.

layers.description: Handles user interface rendering and interactions.
Contains the core logic for processing data and orchestrating actions.

macro_trends.title: High-Level Component Dependency Issues
macro_trends.description: Several Vue files appear to be directly imported into other Vue components, creating potential dependency concerns. This can lead to tight coupling and make refactoring difficult. Specifically, files like 'iLikeCourses.vue' and 'FeeDetails.vue' are being directly imported into components likely intended for more complex functionality. A dependency injection pattern should be considered.

macro_trends.title: Potential State Management Bottlenecks
macro_trends.description: The direct import of components suggests a potential for tightly coupled state management. Without a clear state management strategy (e.g., Vuex), this could lead to inconsistencies and difficulties in maintaining data integrity across the application. Investigate the prop-drilling occurring within the application.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves a student submitting an exam, validating the answers, and generating a result. The sequence includes components for capturing student data, rendering the exam form, and displaying the exam results.

key_workflows.name: Student Profile Management
key_workflows.description: This workflow deals with managing student information, including personal details, educational history, and enrollment status. This includes components for viewing student profiles and updating student information.
